listen_addr.description: IP address the server will bind to. Use `0.0.0.0` for all interfaces.

listen_port.description: SMTP listener port (typically 2525 for greylisting; avoid 25 to prevent conflict with MTA).

worker_count.description: Number of worker threads/processes handling incoming connections.

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Use `-` for stdout.

db_type.description: Database backend: currently only `sqlite` is supported.

db_path.description: Path to the SQLite database file storing greylisting state.

db_max_idle_conns.description: Maximum number of idle connections in the DB pool.

db_max_open_conns.description: Maximum number of open connections to the database.

db_conn_max_lifetime.description: Maximum lifetime of a DB connection before reuse. Accepts duration suffixes like `h`, `m`, `s`.

dnsbl_enabled.description: Enable DNS-based real-time blackhole list lookups to pre-filter obvious spammers.

dnsbl_timeout.description: Timeout for DNSBL queries. Accepts duration suffixes.

dnsbl_providers.description: List of DNSBL providers to query. Each item configures a provider's servers and behavior.

name.description: Unique identifier for this DNSBL provider (e.g., `spamhaus`, `bl-spam`)

servers.description: List of DNSBL domain names to query.

ttl_pass.description: Cache positive (clean) result for this many seconds.

ttl_fail.description: Cache negative (listed) result for this many seconds.

weight.description: Priority weight for weighted DNS queries (higher = queried earlier).

policy_min_delay_sec.description: Minimum delay (seconds) before accepting a retry from a new sender.

policy_max_delay_sec.description: Maximum acceptable delay (seconds); greylisting expires after this if no retry.

policy_accept_after_pass_count.description: Number of successful retries (passes) before permanently accepting the sender.

policy_reject_after_fail_count.description: Number of failed retries (bounces) after which the sender is rejected permanently.

whitelist_networks.description: List of IP ranges (CIDR) that bypass greylisting entirely.

exception_domains.description: List of domains with per-domain greylisting override.

exception_greylist.description: Parallel list: for each domain in `exception_domains`, set to `true` to *force* greylisting, or `false` to *skip* greylisting.
